The project aims to turn the vast Vaca Muerta shale formation into a major source of liquefied natural gas for international markets; it is expected to debut in 2030 if construction moves forward.

The initial development will feature two floating LNG facilities with combined capacity of 12M tons/year, with potential expansion to 18M tons/year, and a 527-km pipeline will transport gas from Vaca Muerta to the Atlantic coast.
